_metadata.description: LAN-visible client inventory and identity confidence.

requirements.title: Device inventory tracks identity with confidence notes
requirements.description: The scenario shall discover and track LAN-visible clients with IP, hostname, MAC or stable identifier when available, resolver usage, group assignment, last seen time, and confidence notes for randomized or ambiguous identities.

validation.notes: Add inventory merge tests tagged [REQ:NM-P0-004] for DHCP/resolver/ARP-like fake sources, randomized identity warnings, and group assignment.
